_comment: name_en -> TOPIS 표준링크 link_id table for the traffic vein (data.seoul.go.kr TrafficInfo, which returns one speed per link_id). Rows below were built by mapping each road name to its 표준링크 ids via the CDSNLAB Seoul TOPIS speed dataset (github.com/cdsnlab/SeoulTrafficData, file 202011.csv, columns 도로명 / 링크아이디), then VERIFYING every id live against TrafficInfo on 29 July 2026 and keeping only ids still returning a numeric prcs_spd. One representative live link per road; the post label is the bare road name, so the exact segment is never shown. Rows whose name_en begins with '_' are ignored. traffic_facts stays silent until at least TWO rows resolve to a live speed. 세종대로 (Sejong-daero) was dropped: none of its 2020 links returned live data. To add a road: find its link ids in the dataset (or TOPIS), verify each is live, then add a {name_en, name_ko, link_id} row.
